visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands wearing plastic gloves pulls apart a golden-brown bagel filled with a thick, white creamy spread containing dark raisins. (2) A man with short black hair wearing a black t-shirt with a husky logo and white plastic gloves stands in a kitchen studio, gesturing while speaking to the camera. (3) A glass bowl contains white flour; a hand pours clear water into it, followed by adding yeast and mixing. (4) The gloved hands knead a pale, sticky dough on a wooden surface inside the glass bowl. (5) The dough is placed on a silicone mat labeled 'Baking Pro' and sliced into six triangular portions using a white plastic scraper. (6) Hands roll the portions into balls and then use a white rolling pin to flatten them into oval shapes. (7) The flattened dough is rolled up and joined into rings, then placed on a black baking tray. (8) A sheet of transparent plastic wrap is pulled over the tray of dough rings for proofing. (9) A pot of dark boiling water on an electric stove is shown; white sugar is poured into it from a glass bowl. (10) A dough ring is dropped into the bubbling water and flipped with black tongs. (11) The boiled dough rings are placed on parchment paper and brushed with a yellow liquid (egg wash) using a yellow silicone brush. (12) Bagels are seen baking inside an oven with a glowing orange light; text overlays indicate temperature and time. (13) In a small bowl, white cream cheese is mixed with dark raisins, crushed walnuts, and red jam using a black spatula. (14) The final shot shows the finished bagel filled with the mixed cream cheese spread, presented on a dark plate.
